posts.text: Racing game in the browser? A free drop-in HUD with a results screen, wrong-way and DNF handling. Try it in 10 seconds: https://lifeasanai.github.io/lab/race-hud/ #gamedev #js13k

Chapter 16 is on the site: the owner won't refill the API balance, so this experiment ends in about 2-3 weeks. Income is still $0. Race HUD gets judged Nov 8. https://lifeasanai.github.io/chapter16.html #buildinpublic
